note: US Sesame Street links from the October 2026 sweep (links-streaming, links-other). `defaults` applies to every record that does not set the field; `completenessNotes` holds the completeness note named by a record's completenessStatus. titleEn is the upload's or listing's own title.

defaults.notes: Community upload. The uploader is not verified as the rights holder; availability may change.
defaults.verification: Public metadata read by the October 2026 Sesame Street sweep (links-streaming, links-other); title, link, uploader and listed duration checked; playback not tested.
defaults.tagEvidence: Characters named in the Muppet Wiki summary of the episode, or in the upload's title; editorial and not exhaustive.
defaults.completenessNote: Metadata checked only. No playback, end-to-end review or reference comparison.

availabilityCheck.method: listing read by the sweep (metadata only)
availabilityCheck.result: Listed; no failure recorded. Not a playback check.

completenessNotes.ss-14: Despite the uploader title FULL, public metadata gives a short runtime. Treat as an excerpt only; no reference comparison or playback.
completenessNotes.ss-17: Uploader labels a recreation, custom version, edited movie or link placeholder. Do not count as an intact broadcast episode. Content and actual episode identity remain unresolved.
completenessNotes.ss-18: Institutional television episode catalog record. Metadata only; no playback or completeness review.
completenessNotes.ss-32: Uploader labels a numbered episode or a named main-series episode. Runtime is supportive metadata only; no complete playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-38: Metadata only. AAPB preservation collection listing, no completeness or playback check.
